items.title: Lowe’s earnings analysis: questions answered and next catalysts
items.summary: Investing.com -- Lowe’s Companies Inc (LOW) beat on the top and bottom lines, but gross margin took the hit. The stock closed at $222.78 on Nov 18 (3:59 PM EST). Pre-market was $218.56 (-1.89%) as of 9:22 AM EST Nov 19, as the market weighed the margin detail more than the headline beat.

items.title: Stocks boosted by Anthropic optimism as the company gets set for IPO
items.summary: The 8:30 hosts, Julie Hyman, Pras Subramanian, and Jake Conley, tackle the top stories of the day, including Anthropic's (ANT) IPO, which priced its stock at $83. Plus, the long-awaited release of Grand Theft Auto 6 is finally here, and sales are expected to hit 3 billion dollars. Plus, Walmart (WMT) raised its outlook as wealthier shoppers continue to seek bargains.

items.title: Walmart's earnings reveal why it's becoming a tech powerhouse
items.summary: Walmart (WMT) raised its full-year outlook following stronger-than-expected earnings, fueled in part by its growing e-commerce business and investments in technology. "The 8:30" hosts Julie Hyman, Pras Subramanian, and Jake Conley discuss Walmart's digital transformation, its expanding partnerships with tech companies, and why investors may want to start thinking of the retail giant as more than just a traditional retailer.

items.summary: Lowe's beat earnings and revenue estimates, but tariff refunds masked underlying weakness as margins compressed and its profit outlook remained unchanged.
